ir_definition: IR = number of majority class instances / number of minority class instances (footnote 1)

chosen.classifier: Naive Bayes (first reported; abstract highlights none)

summary_rows.label: Average AUC over 46 data sets, Naive Bayes (Table 9, p.9)
Rank among 14 methods by average AUC, Naive Bayes (Table 10, p.10)
Sum of ranks over six classifiers (Table 10, p.10)
Final rank over six classifiers (Table 10, p.10)

outcome.stat_test: Friedman test (alpha 0.05; all six p-values < 0.05) then Nemenyi post hoc (alpha 0.05), Fig. 2 p.10; text p.10 states the two combinations outperform RUS, ROS, SMOTE and MetaCost significantly for all six classifiers

win_claim.quote: The experimental results on 46 imbalanced data sets show that our proposed method is usually superior to the conventional imbalance data handling methods when solving the highly imbalanced problems.

uncertain: Proposed method choice: paper presents two data balancing methods (SplitBal, ClusterBal); key is SplitBal so SplitBal+MaxDistance used; ClusterBal+MaxDistance listed as other variant (p.2, p.9)
No per-dataset SMOTE results: paper says 'For space limitations ... we only provide the average AUC values' (p.8); per-dataset AUC only for ClusterBal/SplitBal in Table 8 p.9, so rows left empty
how_obtained set to repository-defined for all 46: paper says some are originally binary, others KEEL-created from multiclass; does not specify per dataset (p.5)
Classifier: abstract highlights none; Naive Bayes chosen as first reported; text names C4.5 but Tables 9/10 print 'J48' (p.9-10)
notes: Binary-only paper (KEEL highly imbalanced, IR 8.10-41.40). Metric is AUC only (G-mean and F-measure explicitly not used, p.6). Per-dataset AUC for SplitBal+MaxDistance across six classifiers exists in Table 8 p.9 (Naive Bayes SplitBal Avg 0.8811). SMOTE appears only as average AUC (Table 9), ranks (Table 10) and Nemenyi plots (Fig. 2). Other variants: five ensemble rules (MaxDistance, MinDistance, ProDistance, MajDistance, SumDistance) vs Kittler rules (Tables 4-7). Weka default params, IBK K=5; SMOTE parameters not stated in paper. Fuzzy comparison Chi3-GTS/Chi5-GTS in Table 11 p.11.
